args: BIN="./bin/code-index-mcp"; if [ ! -x "$BIN" ] || [ ./build.sh -nt "$BIN" ] || [ ./go.mod -nt "$BIN" ] || [ ./go.sum -nt "$BIN" ] || find ./cmd ./internal ./skills -type f -newer "$BIN" -print -quit | grep -q .; then bash ./build.sh; fi; exec "$BIN"

if ! command -v gopls >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'code-index-plugin: gopls 未安装，请执行 go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest' >&2; exit 127; fi; if ! gopls help mcp >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'code-index-plugin: 当前 gopls 不支持 mcp 子命令，请升级到 v0.22.0 或更高版本' >&2; exit 2; fi; exec gopls mcp
